set -eu

conf=$app/config/report.conf
held=$app/config/report.conf.error-test
[ ! -e "$held" ]
before=$(sha256sum "$conf" | awk '{print $1}')
restore() { if [ -e "$held" ]; then mv "$held" "$conf"; fi; }
trap restore EXIT HUP INT TERM
mv "$conf" "$held"
set +e
output=$(cd /tmp && "$app/bin/start-report" 2>&1)
rc=$?
set -e

after=$(sha256sum "$conf" | awk '{print $1}')

[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
[ "$before" = "$after" ]
printf '%s\n' '--- recovered normal output ---'
cd /tmp
"$app/bin/start-report"
